integrity: The Rota-Baxter equations are reconstructed directly from the bracket rather than imported from the low-dimensional table. The automorphism group and conjugation action are derived independently, and finite-field counts are proved from the normal forms and replayed by exhaustive enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the nilpotent two-dimensional cyclic Leibniz algebra and weight zero.
The characteristic-two statement is set-theoretic on field-valued operators; no scheme-structure claim is made.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain an equivalent automorphism quotient.
title: Characteristic-two collapse in the Rota–Baxter moduli of the two-dimensional cyclic Leibniz algebra
